english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a person who sells goods, especially in a shop; it is normally gender-neutral in Cantonese.
This is the direct, all-purpose word for someone whose job is selling goods, especially in a shop.
This is the all-purpose choice when the context already makes clear that the salesperson is a woman.
Use this specifically for a shop or department-store sales clerk rather than any person who sells.

examples.english: The salesman in this shop is very polite.
examples.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅售貨員好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 sau6 fo3 jyun4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

examples.english: I asked a salesperson to come over and check whether they had my size.
examples.traditional: 我叫個售貨員過嚟，問吓有冇我嘅碼。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 go3 sau6 fo3 jyun4 gwo3 lai4 man6 haa2 jau5 mou5 ngo5 ge3 maa5

examples.english: I want to ask the saleswoman whether this shirt comes in other colours.
examples.traditional: 我想問下個售貨員，呢件衫有冇其他顏色？
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa6 go3 sau6 fo3 jyun4 ne1 gin6 saam1 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 ngaan4 sik1

examples.english: The department-store seller was very patient and explained each item to me.
examples.traditional: 百貨公司嗰位售貨員好有耐性，逐件同我介紹。
examples.jyutping: baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 go2 wai6 sau6 fo3 jyun4 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3 zuk6 gin6 tung4 ngo5 gaai3 siu6
